hook.name: PegScapeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the PegScape protocol that mints Runes to buyers based on swap size and market conditions, computing four boost flags (WHALE, DIP, REVENGE, LATE) from pre-swap state captured in transient storage. On sells, it updates a ring buffer tracking recent sellers for the REVENGE flag and drags the DIP price anchor downward as an anti-MEV measure.
